description: Machine-readable spec of the NotifyPush Shortcut. This file is the source of truth for the action list; ios-shortcut/NotifyPush.shortcut is a best-effort binary build of this spec (NOT tested on a real iPhone). See ios-shortcut/BUILD-GUIDE.md for tap-by-tap manual build steps.
fallback: The fallback Dictionary holds exactly one webhook (url/headerName/headerValue). Shortcuts cannot read the destinations stored in the NotifyPush app, so the fallback can only post to this one URL. Leave url as NOT-CONFIGURED to use the app (primary path). The fallback path has no delivery confirmation: the app's History screen is the only place per-destination results are visible.
name: NotifyPush
notes: The notification text is forwarded VERBATIM as body and rawText. Nothing is parsed out of it: no amount, no balance, no direction, no bank logic.
OTP/security-code notifications are never sent (see the OTP filter step). The pattern list is generic only.
receivedAt is ISO-8601 here; the app also accepts epoch milliseconds.
One shortcut copy per source app: duplicate the shortcut and edit the SourceApp Text action (step 20) for each app.

steps.note: Config reminder: set the SourceApp Text action; optionally fill the fallback webhook Dictionary.

params.WFCommentActionText: NotifyPush — forwards a notification verbatim to the NotifyPush iOS app (URL scheme pushnotification://ingest). CONFIG: set the SourceApp Text action below to the source app's name, and optionally fill the fallback webhook Dictionary (url/headerName/headerValue) to POST directly instead of opening the app. One automation per source app (iOS 27+). See BUILD-GUIDE.md.

steps.note: Fallback webhook config. url stays NOT-CONFIGURED unless the direct-POST fallback is wanted.
Automation input = the Notification variable; manual run = shared text / clipboard.
OTP filter pattern (ICU regex, case-insensitive, no lookbehind). Generic patterns only.

params.WFMatchTextPattern: otp|verification code|security code|one-time passcode|one time passcode|do not share|mã otp|mã xác thực|mã xác nhận|mã bảo mật|không chia sẻ

steps.note: If OtpMatch has any value, the notification is an OTP/security code: notify and stop. No data leaves the phone.
Source app name for this copy. Replace CHANGE-ME with the app's display name (e.g. Slack).
Generic notify-push/v1 JSON. [SourceApp], [RawText] (twice), [ReceivedAt] are magic variables; bundleId/title/subtitle stay empty because the automation input is one opaque notification text.
Fallback branch: only when a webhook URL was configured. Otherwise the shortcut falls through to the app handoff.
POST JsonBody to the single fallback webhook. Header name/value come from the Dictionary (variables); if Shortcuts rejects a variable header name, replace both with literal text.

params.WFNotificationActionBody: Sent directly to the fallback webhook.

steps.note: Percent-encode the JSON so it survives as one URL query value.
Opens the NotifyPush app with the payload. The app OTP-filters again, dispatches, and records history.
